items.title: 1995: An Amtrak Sunset Limited train is derailed by saboteurs near Palo Verde, Arizona.
items.summary: The National Railroad Passenger Corporation, doing business as Amtrak, is the national passenger railroad company of the United States. It operates intercity rail service in every contiguous U.S. state except for Wyoming and South Dakota as well as in three Canadian provinces. Amtrak is a portmanteau of the words America and track.

items.title: 1992: The Peekskill meteorite, a 27.7 pounds (12.6 kg) meteorite crashed into a parked car in Peekskill, New York.
items.summary: The Peekskill meteorite is the object resulting from a well-documented meteorite event that occurred in October, 1992, in Peekskill, New York, United States. Sixteen separate video recordings document the meteorite burning through the Earth's atmosphere, whereupon it struck a parked car in Peekskill. The Peekskill meteorite is an H6 monomict breccia; its filigreed texture is the result of the shocking and heating following the impact of two asteroids in outer space. The meteorite is of the…

items.title: 1986: The Phantom of the Opera, eventually the second longest running musical in London, opens at Her Majesty's Theatre.
items.summary: The Phantom of the Opera is a musical with music by Andrew Lloyd Webber, lyrics by Charles Hart, and additional lyrics by Richard Stilgoe, with a libretto by Lloyd Webber and Stilgoe, inspired by the 1910 novel by Gaston Leroux, it tells the tragic story of beautiful soprano Christine Daaé, who becomes the obsession of a mysterious and disfigured musical genius living in the subterranean labyrinth beneath the Paris Opera House.

items.title: 1986: Fox Broadcasting Company (FBC) launches as the fourth US television network.
items.summary: Fox Broadcasting Company, LLC is an American commercial broadcast television network serving as the flagship namesake property of Fox Corporation and operated through Fox Entertainment. The channel was launched by News Corporation on October 9, 1986 as a competitor to the Big Three television networks, which are the American Broadcasting Company (ABC), the Columbia Broadcasting System (CBS) and the National Broadcasting Company (NBC).

items.title: 1984: The popular children's television show Thomas The Tank Engine & Friends, based on The Railway Series by the Reverend Wilbert Awdry, premieres on ITV.
items.summary: Thomas & Friends is a British children's television series developed by Britt Allcroft. Based on The Railway Series children's books by Wilbert and Christopher Awdry, it centers on Thomas the Tank Engine, as well as various anthropomorphic steam locomotives and other vehicles living on the fictional Island of Sodor.

items.title: 1983: South Korean President Chun Doo-hwan survives an assassination attempt in Rangoon, Burma, but the blast kills 21 and injures 17 others.
items.summary: Chun Doo-hwan was a South Korean army general and politician who served as the fifth president of South Korea from 1980 to 1988. A member of the Democratic Justice Party, he ruled the country as a military dictator following a successful coup in December 1979. The period encompassing his presidency is known as the Fifth Republic of Korea.

items.title: 1997: por los estados de Guerrero y Oaxaca (México) pasa el huracán Paulina, y causa la muerte de entre 230 y 400 personas.
items.summary: Guerrero, oficialmente Estado Libre y Soberano de Guerrero, es uno de los treinta y un estados que, junto con la Ciudad de México, conforman México. Su capital es Chilpancingo de los Bravo y su ciudad más poblada es Acapulco de Juárez. Se divide en 85 municipios, agrupados en 7 regiones.

items.title: 1997: en Valencia comienza sus emisiones el canal de televisión Nou Dos.
items.summary: Valencia es un municipio y una ciudad de España, capital de la provincia homónima y de la Comunidad Valenciana. Su población es de 840 792 habitantes, alcanzando los 1 615 223 habitantes si se incluye su espacio urbano, mientras que la región metropolitana tiene 2,5 millones. Es la tercera ciudad y área metropolitana más poblada de España, por detrás de Madrid y Barcelona.

items.title: 1993: en Panamá (Panamá) se funda la logia masónica Harmony Lodge n.º 18, bajo la jurisdicción de la Gran Logia de Panamá.
items.summary: La Ciudad de Panamá es la capital y ciudad más poblada de la República de Panamá, de la Provincia de Panamá y cabecera del Distrito de Panamá. Está ubicada a orillas del océano Pacífico y del golfo de Panamá, sobre la margen oriental de la desembocadura del Canal de Panamá. Dada su posición geográfica, es un punto estratégico para el comercio mundial, y su zona financiera es una de las más importantes globalmente. La ciudad es considerada el "Hub de las Américas" por ser un centro logístico…

items.title: 1989: Canal Nou empieza sus emisiones en la televisión valenciana.
items.summary: Canal Nou fue un canal de televisión abierta español, el primer canal de televisión pública de la Comunidad Valenciana, con sede en Burjasot. Las emisiones regulares empezaron el 9 de octubre de 1989 de la mano de Diego Braguinsky. Fue propiedad del ente público Radiotelevisión Valenciana.
